name: MIDServerSelector
title: MIDServerSelector - Global
summary: The MIDServerSelector script include provides methods to find a MID Server based on capabilities and target IP address.
overview: Use in server scripts to find a MID Server with specific capabilities.

members.name: findAgent
members.summary: Finds the MID server based on the capabilities and target IP address.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
target String The target IP address
Returns
Type Description
void 
var mss = new MIDServerSelector();
var capab = ["ssh","wmi","snmp"];
mss.setCapabilities(capab);
mss.findAgent('100.101.10.10');

members.name: getError
members.summary: Gets the error messages for the current MID server.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
void 
var mss = new MIDServerSelector();
var capab = ["ssh","wmi","snmp"];
mss.setCapabilities(capab);
mss.findAgent('100.101.10.10');
mss.getError();

members.name: setCapabilities
members.summary: Sets the technologies for which to look.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
capabilities Array A list of capabilities, for example - capabilities = ["ssh","wmi","snmp",{"os_domain":"disco"},{"phase":1}];
Returns
Type Description
void 
var mss = new MIDServerSelector();
var capab = ["ssh","wmi","snmp"];
mss.setCapabilities(capab);
